Developing a platform evolution roadmap

Connecting market needs with a practical direction for product development.

The objective

Help a technology business assess the market opportunity for its construction project collaboration platform, understand its existing capabilities and determine how the platform should evolve.

Shyam and Mak’s contribution

Shyam and Mak worked with the business on a market assessment, a diagnostic of the platform’s current capabilities and an evolution strategy.

The work brought the market and product perspectives together: what the platform could address, what it could already support and where further development was needed.

The output

A platform evolution strategy supported by a two-year phased roadmap, providing a sequence for development rather than treating every improvement as an immediate priority.

Status

The company’s platform evolution is underway through the phased roadmap. Implementation remains in progress; the case describes assessment and strategic direction, not completed commercial results.

Source: Shyam Sundar Pani and Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Combining market assessment and capability diagnostics into an actionable development roadmap.
